name: Gold (fear gauge)
summary: Gold near $4,050, down 7.9% over three months, just inside the Normal band
state: Gold futures were near $4,052 at 11:30 UK on 4 Nov, up 0.5% over the week and 7.9% lower over three months, back inside the 8% fall Watch line after dipping past it earlier in the day. They remain about 24% below their 52-week high. Recent weakness reflects higher yields and expected rate rises rather than a flight to safety.
for_you: Gold is no longer signalling unusual stress on its three-month move. Prices remain well below their peak, which affects holders of gold and gold-linked savings.
rubric_hit: Gold 3m gain -7.48% below the 10% Watch line
why: Gold is the oldest crisis hedge; disorderly surges signal fear about currencies, inflation or geopolitics.
drivers: Real interest rates, central-bank buying, geopolitical fear, dollar moves.

rubric.alert: 3-month gain > 20%, or a single-week move > 7% either way.
